groups.prompt:
Game walk-cycle sprite sheet. Reference image contains FOUR animal identities in 2x2 order: top-left rabbit, top-right otter, bottom-left squirrel, bottom-right hedgehog. Preserve each character's exact design, face, fur colors, thick dark-brown outline, pastel saturation and cute proportions.
OUTPUT: exactly EIGHT columns and FOUR rows of separate full-body sprites, on TRUE TRANSPARENT background. Row 1 ONLY rabbit, row 2 ONLY otter, row 3 ONLY squirrel, row 4 ONLY hedgehog. Eight chronological WALK poses per row. No labels, no border, no shadows, no furniture.
All characters walk upright on TWO legs, steady right-facing THREE-QUARTER view (never turn front/back). Camera and character sizes constant within each row, centered in equal cells with generous gaps. Walking legs have a wider clear fore-aft stride, feet alternately pass each other: 1 near foot forward/far foot back, 2 weight over near foot, 3 far foot passes near foot lifting just slightly, 4 far foot reaches forward, 5 far foot forward/near back, 6 weight over far foot, 7 near foot passes far, 8 near reaches forward toward pose1. Low foot clearance, flat planted soles, no jumping or high kicks. Small hips/chest counter-turn, gentle breathing/head bob, natural opposite arm swing. Tail/ears lag softly. Exactly TWO arms total and TWO feet. Birds ( ) have exactly TWO wings/flippers, NEVER a second pair of chest hands. Keep same-colored fur on both feet, no dark sole/black feet except naturally black panda paws. The body, head and face subtly change with weight transfer, not separate cut-out pieces. Ensure visibly different alternating foot-over-foot contact poses, smooth adjacent pose changes. Every sprite must be completely within its own cell. Maintain original animal style and recognizable facial features.
